description: Search the published DCAST documentation (developer API pages, errors and limits, embedding, access modes, webhooks, plans, prices and limits) and get the matching sections word for word, each with its source link. Use this BEFORE writing any integration code or answering "can DCAST do X" or "which plan allows X"; do not invent endpoints, fields or limits that are not in the results. Query with a few specific words, for example "password stream embed", "restream destinations per plan", "webhook signature verification".

limit.description: How many sections to return, default 5

query.description: A few specific words describing what you need to know

name: dcast_search_docs
title: Search the DCAST documentation
